newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean opposition agrees to ratify OECD admission.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean opposition agrees to ratify OECD admission.

text.p: South Korea's opposition parties agreed on Tuesday to support membership of the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), a ruling party statement said.
Seoul was invited to join the Paris-based club of rich nations on October 11, but opposition parties had threatened to block ratification in parliament.

On Tuesday parliamentary representatives of South Korea's three main political parties -- the ruling New Korea Party and the opposition National Congress for New Politics and the United Liberal Democrats -- signed an agreement to bring the issue to a vote on November 26, the statement said.
Spokesmen for the opposition parties confirmed their members would vote in favour.

Opposition parties were not opposed to OECD membership in principle, but said they wanted a delay because the country's troubled economy could not withstand the shock of further market liberalisation.
